name: tr_horford
caption:
IF HORFORD WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐊 Feraligatr, the gator: NCAA champion at Florida in 2006 and 2007
🦅 Talonflame, the hawk: #3 pick to Atlanta in 2007
⭐ Jirachi, the star: 5-time All-Star
⏳ Celebi, the long wait: 186 playoff games before his first ring, an NBA record
💥 Clawitzer, the cannon: 41.7% from three through 8 games
🐘 Copperajah, the ace: Big Al, 40 years old, back for season 20

Which one would you add? 👇

beats.head: HORFORD'S TEAM

facts.claim: Horford, nicknamed Big Al, born June 3, 1986 (age 40); 2x NCAA champion at Florida (2006, 2007); drafted 3rd overall (#3) in 2007 by Atlanta; 5x All-Star; first NBA championship in 2024 in his 186th career playoff game, the record for most playoff games before a championship; re-signed with Golden State June 25, 2026 to play his 20th season
